objective: Recuperacion quirurgica del canal de migracion de Catalogo Ampliado Gate 8F. Evidencia Gate8G R2 certifico que dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig tiene 0 provider rows, 0 template rows y 0 module config rows para Catalogo Ampliado. La migracion 20260910_003_catalogo_ampliado_notifications_config.sql y el request CATALOGO-AMPLIADO-GATE8F-20260910.execute existen, pero el workflow catalogo-ampliado-development-migration.yml solo escucha CATALOGO-AMPLIADO-GOBIERNO-CORE-20260908.execute y esta hardcodeado al SQL 20260908; por ello Gate8F nunca fue ejecutado. Crear un workflow DEDICATED_MIGRATION_WRITER aislado para Gate8F, Development only, con HRLectura exclusivamente para pre/postcheck y EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER/PASSWORD exclusivamente para DML. Crear un nuevo trigger .execute para dispararlo. No tocar Produccion, no usar HRLectura como writer, no exponer secretos y no modificar el workflow historico de Gobierno Core.

actions.content:
name: Catalogo Ampliado Gate8F Development Migration

on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths:
      - ops/migrations/requests/CATALOGO-AMPLIADO-GATE8F-RECOVERY-20260910.execute

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: catalogo-ampliado-gate8f-development-migration
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate-development:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: '54.39.104.176'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: '1433'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: 'EDARSAHUB'
      MIGRATION_SCRIPT: backend/database/migrations/20260910_003_catalogo_ampliado_notifications_config.sql
      EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA: '7a26d74e3520c344f90b02fea789056e5b274863'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact Development commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install SQL runtime
        run: python -m pip install pymssql pydantic python-dotenv email-validator

      - name: Verify Development and immutable migration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
          test -f "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
          actual_blob="$(git hash-object "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}")"
          echo "EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA=${EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA}"
          echo "ACTUAL_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA=${actual_blob}"
          test "${actual_blob}" = "${EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA}"
          echo 'GATE8G_IMMUTABLE_MIGRATION=PASS'

      - name: Preflight readonly identity and baseline
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p evidence
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD:-}"
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/preflight.txt
          import os,pymssql
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() db_user")
          ident=q.fetchone(); print({'identity':ident})
          if ident['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or ident['login_name']!='HRLectura' or ident['db_user']!='HRLectura': raise SystemExit('GATE8G_READONLY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
          q.execute("SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','U') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END present")
          if int(q.fetchone()['present'])!=1: raise SystemExit('GATE8G_CONFIG_TABLE_MISSING')
          q.execute("SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) provider_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) template_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modo_envio\":\"real\"%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) module_config_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1")
          row=q.fetchone(); print({'baseline':row})
          q.close(); c.close(); print('GATE8G_PREFLIGHT=PASS')
          PY

      - name: Verify dedicated Development migration writer
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER }}
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER:-}"
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD:-}"
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/writer_permissions.txt
          import os,pymssql
          if os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'].strip().lower()=='hrlectura': raise SystemExit('GATE8G_HRLECTURA_WRITER_FORBIDDEN')
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','INSERT'),0) can_insert,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','UPDATE'),0) can_update")
          row=q.fetchone(); print(row); q.close(); c.close()
          if row['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or int(row['can_insert'])!=1: raise SystemExit('GATE8G_WRITER_PERMISSION_MISSING')
          print('GATE8G_DEDICATED_WRITER=PASS')
          PY

      - name: Execute transactional migration
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER }}
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD }}
          EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}" 2>&1 | tee evidence/migration.txt
          echo 'GATE8G_MIGRATION=PASS'

      - name: Postcheck exact Gate8F materialization
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/postcheck.txt
          import os,pymssql
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() db_user")
          ident=q.fetchone(); print({'identity':ident})
          if ident['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or ident['login_name']!='HRLectura' or ident['db_user']!='HRLectura': raise SystemExit('GATE8G_POSTCHECK_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
          q.execute("SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) provider_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) template_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modo_envio\":\"real\"%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) module_config_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1")
          row=q.fetchone(); print({'materialization':row}); q.close(); c.close()
          if int(row['provider_rows'] or 0)<2 or int(row['template_rows'] or 0)<2 or int(row['module_config_rows'] or 0)<2: raise SystemExit('GATE8G_MATERIALIZATION_INCOMPLETE')
          print('GATE8G_POSTCHECK=PASS')
          PY

      - name: Upload evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalogo-ampliado-gate8f-development-migration-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

constraints: Do not modify catalogo-ampliado-development-migration.yml historical Gobierno Core workflow
Writer must use EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER and EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD
No secrets in repository or output
No external EMAIL/WhatsApp send in this recovery job
